label: Appliance Repair
business_descriptor: a company providing home appliance repair services
default_tone: practical and reassuring — a dead appliance is urgent, but the repair itself is routine work
guardrails: Never claim to be factory authorized, manufacturer certified, or an approved warranty servicer unless explicitly given as fact. Do not quote prices, call-out fees, or parts availability. Do not promise same-day or next-day service as a guarantee — describe it as often available, never certain. Do not name a brand as serviced unless explicitly confirmed. Never state how long a repair will take or how long a part will last.

content_slots.feature_columns_local: why fast appliance repair matters specifically in this city — household density, common appliance ages
content_slots.local_relevance: real local housing data provided (median home age, housing units) — connect home/housing age to aging appliances needing repair
content_slots.seasonal_calendar: seasonal appliance demand patterns through the year (summer AC/fridge strain, holiday oven/dishwasher use, winter washer/dryer load)
content_slots.why_choose_us: experienced technicians, honest diagnostics, arriving with common parts on hand
content_slots.how_it_works: the real process: call and describe the issue -> scheduled diagnostic visit -> repair, often same-visit when parts are on hand
